title: Shamrock, The Truth & Jarrett: the first title struggle
summary: TNA launches around the NWA championship. Ken Shamrock establishes the first reign of the new promotion, Ron Killings breaks through, and Jeff Jarrett takes control of the title picture.

chapters.title: Shamrock wins the launch-night championship
chapters.result: Ken Shamrock defeats Malice to win the vacant NWA world championship.
chapters.context: The opening Gauntlet for the Gold narrows to a singles finish, establishing the prize around which the new company’s main-event rivalries will revolve.

chapters.title: The Truth takes the title
chapters.result: Ron Killings defeats Shamrock for the NWA world championship.
chapters.context: Killings turns his demand for recognition into a championship breakthrough. Jarrett remains a threat as the promotion’s first major title struggle changes direction.

chapters.title: Jarrett begins his first reign
chapters.result: Jeff Jarrett defeats Ron Killings to become NWA world champion.
chapters.context: The title moves to Jarrett, whose grip on the championship becomes a central obstacle for TNA’s emerging challengers.
